qualification: local A05.3 reliability isolation failure; not performance evidence, cross-host evidence, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.configuration: Tier-one direct chaining and the generated IBTC enabled; legacy direct chaining and shadow returns disabled.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Add the independently accepted IBTC to the higher-avoidance Tier-one-direct production boundary without enabling either previously rejected direct-source coexistence or shadow-return state.
candidate.productionFinding: The first exact-binary run crashed before terminal output or a diagnostic receipt. The macOS crash report records a null instruction fetch with PC, LR, and FP all zero while generated memory callback pointers remained live in the callee-saved register bank. The combination is rejected despite both predictors passing their independent two-run gates.

verification.focused: 39 tests in two suites passed, covering predictor isolation, IBTC invalidation, shadow accounting isolation, and the PC machine.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,558 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled.

failedRun.registerObservation: x19 and x20 resolve to generated JIT memory callback thunks while PC/LR/FP are zero.

disposition.reason: A production crash rejects the combination immediately. Independent predictor acceptance does not establish combination safety, and no missing-receipt counters are inferred.

limitations: The crash report proves null host control flow but does not identify the exact generated edge or preceding architectural divergence.
No diagnostic receipt was produced, so guest progress and predictor activity are unknown.
The result does not invalidate the separate Tier-one-direct-only or IBTC-only two-run acceptance boundaries.
A future combination attempt requires binary-layout-neutral or out-of-process first-divergence evidence rather than another blind reintroduction.
